name: Ribeirão do Pinhal (Brazil)
description: Royal blue field with a broad white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Ribeirão do Pinhal is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 27 October 1967 (prescribed with the arms by Municipal Law No. 355 of 27 October 1967, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown and a landscape, reading RIBEIRÃO DO PINHAL
